## Report

### Actions taken
- Loaded the ExperimentData from `data/car_stopping_distance` containing 50 car stopping samples
- Split data using `train_test_split(row index, train_size=0.75, random_state=1987)` yielding 37 training and 13 test rows
- Independently recomputed M1 model: lstsq of y on [x, x²] (no intercept), calculated sd_parameter as numpy.std of training residuals (ddof=0)
- Independently recomputed M2 model: lstsq of y/x on [1, x] (no intercept), calculated sd_parameter as numpy.std of residuals (ddof=0)
- Calculated coverage (fraction of y within mean ± 1.96σ) and NLL (mean of -log normal density) on test rows for both models
- Compared all recomputed values to M1.csv and M2.csv file values
- Created `results/check.md` with detailed comparison tables and verification status
